<?php
// Test site only. Playground's PHP reports the "cli" SAPI, so Acorn would
// treat every web request as a console run and print its command list
// instead of the site. Tell it these are web requests, as on a real server,
// and give Symfony Console the array $_SERVER['argv'] it expects.
putenv( 'APP_RUNNING_IN_CONSOLE=false' );
$_ENV['APP_RUNNING_IN_CONSOLE']    = 'false';
$_SERVER['APP_RUNNING_IN_CONSOLE'] = 'false';
if ( isset( $_SERVER['argv'] ) && ! is_array( $_SERVER['argv'] ) ) {
	$_SERVER['argv'] = array();
}
